NVIDIA and Meta to Expand Collaboration on Muse and Muse Family of Models Amid Robust Growth

October 26, 2026 News Summary: NVIDIA and Meta will expand their partnership on Muse and the Muse family of models, reflecting popular demand for AI agents. The companies are also considering other technological collaborations, including NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture to strengthen agency security and NVIDIA Sentry for monitoring, structured, unstructured and graph data processing. Meta to expand NVIDIA Vera Rubin and Vera CPU deployment to boost performance and scale workloads with NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking and BlueField-4. NVIDIA and Meta today announced they will partner to expand their work on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance, reflecting popular demand for useful AI agents. Meta’s Muse models and agents, which leverage NVIDIA’s infrastructure, have delivered frontier-level benchmark performance and surging consumer downloads since launch. Meta and NVIDIA intend to further deepen their collaboration by partnering on optimizations across workflows to maximize performance and improve total cost of ownership. Meta and NVIDIA will also consider additional collaboration opportunities with NVIDIA on its NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture, including NVIDIA OpenShell™ for safe deployment and NVIDIA Sentry for monitoring agent behavior. This announcement reinforces Meta and NVIDIA’s strong long-term partnership to support Meta’s AI infrastructure ambitions.
